notes: dfe-gcse-maths: the DfE document numbers statements 1, 2, ... within each section; refs are recorded as e.g. "Number 1" and ids use the N1/A1/R1/G1/P1/S1 convention that AQA and Pearson print. Tiering read from the PDF fonts (bold) and drawn underlines.
Mapping status counts use the best fit among an outcome's lessons; many partials are statements split across several lessons that together cover them (see each entry's note).

dfe-alevel-maths: mechanics (P1, Q1-Q5, R1-R6, S1) is the weakest area: only the overview lesson u28-08 and undergraduate u20-29 touch it; R5 (resultant forces, dynamics in a plane) is a gap. Also weak: graphs of a^x/e^x (F1), log graphs for y = ax^n and y = kb^x (F6), small-angle approximations (E2), change-of-sign root location (I1).

aqa-8300 (file aqa-8300-maths.js) and edexcel-1ma1 (file edexcel-1ma1-maths.js): both boards print the N1..S6 references themselves, so those are the outcomes (97 each); no coverage mappings, as they inherit dfe-gcse-maths. AQA summaries give AQA's tier columns; Pearson summaries compare its Foundation and Higher lists (11 references are Higher only: A13, A15, A16, A20, R15, G8, G10, G22, G23, P9, S3).
edexcel-1ma1: the extracted PDF is Issue 2 (June 2015); Pearson may have later issues. Pearson's own A1 reads "algebraic manipulation" where the DfE says "algebraic notation"; kept as printed.
Spec ids follow kit/curriculum/catalogue/uk.js SPEC_BY_CODE (aqa-8300, edexcel-1ma1, aqa-8700), as aqa-8461-biology.js uses id aqa-8461; file names are as the task named them.

aqa-8700: GCSE Core has no writing or spoken-language lessons, so AO5, AO6 (50% of the GCSE between them), AO7-AO9, 3.1.2, 3.1.3, both Section B writing tasks and the Spoken Language endorsement are gaps; reading AOs are only partial (literary close reading, no unseen non-fiction, 19th-century sources, summary/synthesis or comparison of viewpoints).
Not run: npm test / npm run qa (per brief). The catalogue or engine may need wiring for the new coverage files; not touched.
